title: Appointment Fee Schedule for In-Person Appointments
content:
**Schedule of cancellation notice and appointment fees, In-Person Appointments.** The figures below are set per visit type and are read by the cancellation, missed-appointment, attendance and fee-waiver rules.

| Visit type | Cancellation notice (hours) | Late-cancellation fee | No-show fee | First no-show waived | Late cancellation counts as a missed appointment | Waiver documentation window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 24 | $15.00 | $25.00 | Yes | No | 7 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 24 | $25.00 | $50.00 | Yes | No | 7 |
| New Patient Office Visit | 24 | $40.00 | $75.00 | Yes | No | 7 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 24 | $25.00 | $50.00 | Yes | No | 7 |
| Specialist Consultation | 48 | $40.00 | $75.00 | Yes | Yes | 7 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 72 | $75.00 | $125.00 | No | Yes | 10 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 72 | $100.00 | $150.00 | No | Yes | 10 |

### Column definitions

- **Cancellation notice** is the visit type's cancellation notice, stated in hours.
- **Late-cancellation fee** is the visit type's fee for a patient cancellation that is not timely, in US dollars.
- **No-show fee** is the visit type's fee for a missed appointment, in US dollars.
- **First no-show waived** records whether the patient's first no-show of the visit type inside the look-back is waived rather than charged.
- **Late cancellation counts as a missed appointment** records whether a late cancellation of the visit type counts toward the no-show thresholds.
- **Waiver documentation window** is the number of calendar days after the scheduled date of a missed or late-cancelled visit within which emergency documentation must be supplied for a fee waiver.

### Notes on the schedule

- The no-show fee is higher than the late-cancellation fee for every visit type; the widest gap is on the Advanced Imaging Appointment, $150.00 against $100.00.
- The In-Office Procedure Visit and the Advanced Imaging Appointment are the two visit types with No in the first-no-show column, and both carry a documentation window of 10 calendar days.
- Three visit types count a late cancellation as a missed appointment: the Specialist Consultation, the In-Office Procedure Visit and the Advanced Imaging Appointment.
